svg.title: An opaque request turns inward
svg.desc: Make the route turn toward the internal service through an opaque mechanism block. Direction and crossed scope carry the concept; hidden mechanics must remain hidden. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.
